description: OpenCode 2.3.0 in run mode with cetra's plugin: one shell call (cat hello.txt), then the answer; traces with prompts.
notes: OpenCode's spans come from cetra's own plugin (D-IN-29 item 1), loaded from the config dir; the config file it reads is the one `cetra agents setup opencode` writes. The provider is OpenCode's openai entry pointed at the mock with the mock key. OpenCode names its shell tool `shell` (read from the tool list the build sends); its only required parameter is command. The first turn is the session-title call OpenCode makes beside the main flow, so it is an auxiliary turn served to the request that declares no tools; the plugin emits no span for it. The default plugins are off and the update, model and LSP fetches are disabled, so nothing leaves loopback. gen_ai.conversation.id is OpenCode's session id, which differs between runs, so it is volatile. gen_ai.input.messages carries OpenCode's own message ids, so the check ignores its value. gen_ai.tool.call.id is the mock's tool-call id and stable.
